name: AssemblyAI
tagline: Speech-to-text and speech AI APIs
description: AssemblyAI's pricing page covers speech-to-text, text-to-speech and an LLM Gateway, with a free tier and pay-as-you-go per-hour rates.

name: Bolt
tagline: Prompt, run and deploy full-stack apps in the browser
description: Bolt (bolt.new) is a browser-based AI app builder with token-based usage on Free, Pro, Teams and Enterprise plans.
keyFeature: Monthly AI token allowance per plan

name: Canva
tagline: Template-based design tool
description: Canva is a template-based design tool for social posts, presentations, resumes and simple logos, made for people who are not designers.
keyFeature: Templates for social posts, presentations and documents

name: ChatGPT
tagline: General-purpose AI assistant from OpenAI
description: ChatGPT is OpenAI's chat assistant. You describe what you need in plain language and it replies in text, which people use for drafts, outlines, explanations and ideas.
keyFeature: Chat-based assistant for writing, analysis and questions

name: Claude
tagline: AI assistant from Anthropic
description: Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant, used to write, analyse, work through problems and handle longer documents, with separate plans for individuals, teams and enterprises.
bestFor: Individuals and Teams of 2 to 150 users (Team plan)
keyFeature: Chat on web, desktop and mobile

name: Consensus
tagline: AI search engine for scientific research
description: Consensus is an AI research tool for finding answers in scientific papers. Its pricing page lists Individual plus Team and Enterprise options.

name: Microsoft Copilot
tagline: AI assistant from Microsoft
description: Microsoft describes Copilot as an AI assistant that helps you create, research, analyse and get things done in the Microsoft 365 apps you use. Individual access comes through Microsoft 365 plans.
bestFor: People who work in Microsoft 365 and Families (Family plan, owner only for AI features)
keyFeature: Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook (desktop)

name: Cursor
tagline: AI code editor with agents
description: Cursor is an AI-assisted code editor. Its pricing page lists Free, Plus, Premium, Super and Ultra individual plans plus Teams and Enterprise.
bestFor: Individual developers and Teams (Teams and Enterprise plans)
keyFeature: AI usage pool shared across Cursor products

name: Deepgram
tagline: Speech-to-text, text-to-speech and voice agent APIs
description: Deepgram provides speech-to-text, text-to-speech, voice agent and audio intelligence APIs, billed per minute of audio.
keyFeature: Speech-to-text, text-to-speech and voice agent APIs

name: DeepL
tagline: AI translation and writing assistant
description: DeepL translates text and documents between languages and offers a Write Pro add-on for writing assistance, with individual, team and business plans.

name: Descript
tagline: Edit video and audio by editing text
description: Descript is a video and audio editor with AI features, priced per person with media hours and AI credits.
keyFeature: Media hours and AI credits per month

name: Devin
tagline: AI coding agents and editor
description: Devin is Cognition's AI coding product. The old windsurf.com/pricing address now redirects to devin.ai/pricing, which lists Free, Pro, Max, Teams and Enterprise plans.
bestFor: Individual developers and Teams of up to 200 users
keyFeature: Unlimited Tab completions and inline edits on the free plan

name: ElevenLabs
tagline: AI voice, speech and music
description: ElevenLabs offers text-to-speech, speech-to-text, sound effects, voice design and music, sold as credit-based plans from Free to Enterprise.
keyFeature: Text to speech and speech to text

name: Elicit
tagline: AI research assistant for academic papers
description: Elicit is an AI research assistant for finding and analysing academic papers, with a free Basic plan and Pro, Scale and Enterprise plans.
keyFeature: Search across more than 138 million papers

name: Fathom
tagline: AI meeting partner that records and summarises calls
description: Fathom records and transcribes calls and produces instant AI summaries, with a free plan and paid plans for individuals and teams.
keyFeature: Unlimited recordings and transcriptions on the Free plan

name: Figma
tagline: Collaborative interface design
description: Figma is a browser-based design tool for website and app interfaces, with plans priced per seat type (Full, Dev and Collab).
keyFeature: Seat types: Full, Dev and Collab

name: Fireflies.ai
tagline: AI meeting notetaker and transcription
description: Fireflies.ai records and transcribes meetings and audio files, and its paid plans add integrations, analytics and team features.

name: Adobe Firefly
tagline: Generative AI for images, video, audio and translation
description: Adobe Firefly is Adobe's generative AI service. Its plans are measured in monthly generative credits and cover images, short video, translation, sound effects and music.
bestFor: Creators and Design and marketing teams

plans.name: Pro / Pro Plus / Premium for teams

name: Fireworks AI
tagline: Fast inference and fine-tuning for open models, billed by use
description: Fireworks AI runs open models through a serverless API and dedicated GPU deployments, and offers managed fine-tuning, with usage-based billing.

name: Gamma
tagline: AI presentations, documents and websites
description: Gamma is an AI tool for creating presentations, documents and simple websites.

name: Gemini
tagline: AI assistant from Google
description: Gemini is Google's AI assistant, offered through the Gemini app and Google AI subscription plans for individuals, plus Business and Enterprise options.
bestFor: Individuals who use Google services and Businesses (Gemini Enterprise)

name: GitHub Copilot
tagline: AI coding assistant inside your editor and on GitHub
description: GitHub Copilot is an AI coding assistant with inline suggestions, chat, an agent mode and a command-line tool, sold in Free, Pro, Pro+ and Max plans plus business offerings.
bestFor: Individual developers and Teams (business and enterprise offerings)

name: Grammarly
tagline: Spelling, grammar and tone checker
description: Grammarly checks spelling, grammar and tone as you type in the browser and many apps, and offers AI prompts for rewriting and drafting.
keyFeature: Writing mistake checks and tone view

name: Granola
tagline: AI notepad for meetings
description: Granola is an AI notepad that takes meeting notes and offers AI chat across meetings, with desktop, iOS, Android and Apple Watch apps.

name: Groq
tagline: Fast AI inference cloud
description: Groq describes itself as a cloud provider focused on fast AI inference, built around its own LPU hardware.

name: HeyGen
tagline: AI avatar videos and translation
description: HeyGen creates videos with AI avatars and voices, with credit-based plans from a free plan to Business and Enterprise.
bestFor: Marketing and training teams and Creators

name: Hostinger
tagline: Beginner-friendly web hosting
description: Hostinger sells web hosting, VPS and a website builder aimed at first-time site owners. Hosting plans are paid upfront for a multi-year term.
bestFor: First-time site owners and Agencies (Agency Startup)
keyFeature: Premium, Unlimited, Cloud Startup and Agency Startup hosting plans

name: Hugging Face
tagline: Hub for open models, datasets and Spaces
description: Hugging Face hosts open models, datasets and apps (Spaces), with a PRO account, Team and Enterprise plans plus pay-as-you-go compute and storage.

name: Ideogram
tagline: AI image generator known for text in images
description: Ideogram is an AI image generation service.

name: Intercom
tagline: Customer service platform with the Fin AI agent
description: Intercom is a customer service platform with seat-based plans and an AI agent, Fin, billed per outcome.

name: Jasper
tagline: AI platform for marketing teams
description: Jasper is an AI platform aimed at marketing teams, with agents, brand voices and a canvas for content creation.

name: LangSmith
tagline: Observability and deployment for AI agents
description: LangSmith is LangChain's platform for tracing, evaluating and deploying AI applications, priced per seat plus pay-as-you-go usage.
keyFeature: Trace retention of 14 days (base) or 180 days (extended)

name: Leonardo.Ai
tagline: AI image and asset generation platform
description: Leonardo.Ai is an AI image generation platform.

name: Lovable
tagline: Describe an app and have AI build it
description: Lovable is an AI app builder that works on a credit system. Its pricing page names Free, Pro, Business and Enterprise plans.
bestFor: Non-developers and Founders and small teams
keyFeature: Credit-based building (default mode varies by task; Plan Mode costs 1 credit per message)

name: Luma
tagline: AI video and image generation with Luma and third-party models
description: Luma offers credit-based individual plans (Plus, Pro, Ultra) for generating video and images, plus Team and Enterprise plans on request.
keyFeature: Luma and third-party image and video models

name: Make
tagline: Visual automation platform
description: Make is an automation platform with credit-based plans: Free, Core, Pro, Teams and Enterprise, plus a Start-up plan.

name: Midjourney
tagline: AI image generator
description: Midjourney generates images from text descriptions and is used for concept art and visual ideas.

name: Le Chat (Mistral)
tagline: AI assistant and models from Mistral AI
description: Le Chat is Mistral AI's assistant, available on the web and mobile, with a free plan, paid individual and team plans, and a separate pay-as-you-go API for Mistral's models.
keyFeature: Web search, image generation and editing

name: n8n
tagline: Workflow automation you can self-host
description: n8n is a workflow automation tool with hosted cloud plans and a self-hosted Community Edition on GitHub.

name: Namecheap
tagline: Domain names and hosting
description: Namecheap is a domain name registrar that also sells hosting and related services.

name: NotebookLM
tagline: Source-grounded notebooks from Google
description: NotebookLM is Google's notebook tool for working with your own sources. Google's current support page for it is titled Gemini Notebook and describes free and paid tiers by notebook and source limits.

name: Notion
tagline: Notes, docs and databases in one workspace
description: Notion combines notes, documents and databases in one workspace. Its pricing page positions it as 'one tool to run your company', with Free, Plus, Business and Enterprise plans.
bestFor: Individuals and Students and educators (free Plus for 1 member)

name: Ollama
tagline: Run models locally, with optional cloud models
description: Ollama is a tool for running large language models on your own hardware, with optional paid plans for cloud-hosted models. Its source code is published on GitHub under the MIT licence.
keyFeature: Runs models on your own hardware, which the FAQ says is always unlimited

name: OpenRouter
tagline: One API for hundreds of models
description: OpenRouter provides an OpenAI-compatible API that gives access to 500+ models from 80+ providers. Model usage is billed per token at each provider's list price.
bestFor: Developers and Teams building AI products

name: Otter.ai
tagline: AI meeting notes and transcription
description: Otter.ai records and transcribes meetings and conversations, with a free Basic plan and Pro, Business and Enterprise plans priced per user.
keyFeature: Meeting and recording minutes per user

name: Perplexity
tagline: AI answer engine with cited sources
description: Perplexity is an AI answer engine that searches the web and shows the sources behind an answer, so you can open and check them.

name: Pika
tagline: Credit-based AI video generation
description: Pika is an AI video and image generation service with a free plan and Starter, Creator and Fancy paid plans.
bestFor: Creators and Social and marketing teams

name: QuillBot
tagline: Paraphraser, grammar checker and writing tools
description: QuillBot offers a paraphraser, grammar checker, summariser, translator, citation generator and AI detector, with a free plan and a paid Premium plan.

name: Replicate
tagline: Run open and custom AI models through an API, billed by use
description: Replicate lets developers run public and private machine-learning models through an API and pay as they go, by run time, output or tokens.

name: Replit
tagline: Browser-based coding and app building with AI
description: Replit is an online coding environment with an AI agent for building and deploying apps. Its pricing page lists Core, Pro and Enterprise plans.
bestFor: Individuals and Small teams (Pro, up to 15 collaborators)
keyFeature: Chat and agent with 'Free Mode' usage

name: Runway
tagline: AI video and image generation studio
description: Runway is a credit-based studio for generating and editing video and images with AI, with plans from Free to Max.
bestFor: Creators and Marketing and video teams
keyFeature: Credits for AI video and image models

name: Scite
tagline: Search scientific papers and see how they cite each other
description: Scite is an AI-powered platform that helps researchers discover and evaluate scientific literature, using Smart Citations to show whether studies support or contradict a claim.
keyFeature: Assistant and search across scientific literature

name: Suno
tagline: AI music and song generation
description: Suno generates songs from text, with a free plan and Pro and Premier paid plans.

name: Surfer
tagline: SEO and AI search visibility platform
description: Surfer describes itself as a platform for AI Search Optimization and visibility, with plans measured in tracked AI prompts, documents, pages and seats.
keyFeature: AI prompts tracked on a refresh schedule

name: Synthesia
tagline: AI presenter videos from text
description: Synthesia turns text into videos with AI presenters and dubbing, with a free Basic plan and Starter, Pro and Enterprise plans.
bestFor: Businesses and Training and communications teams

name: Together AI
tagline: Inference, fine-tuning and GPU clusters
description: Together AI's pricing page covers serverless inference, dedicated endpoints, fine-tuning and GPU clusters, with a 'Start for free' option.

name: v0
tagline: AI that generates interfaces and apps
description: v0 is Vercel's AI app and interface builder, priced per user with monthly credits, plus a separate per-token API.
keyFeature: Monthly and daily credits per user

name: Wispr Flow
tagline: Dictation that types into any app
description: Wispr Flow is a dictation app that turns speech into written text in any app, and it also offers a Notetaker for meetings.
bestFor: Professionals and Students (50% off Pro with an education email)
keyFeature: Dictation on Mac, Windows, iOS and Android

name: Writesonic
tagline: AI search visibility and content platform
description: Writesonic's pricing page lists plans measured in tracked AI prompts and answers, AI articles per month, site audits and users.
keyFeature: AI prompts and answers tracked daily

name: Zapier
tagline: Workflow automation with AI agents and chatbots
description: Zapier connects apps into automated workflows and offers AI agents and chatbots as add-ons, with plans measured in monthly tasks.
